card.text: Young orange dwarf 50 parsecs away in Pictor, with a companion at the planet and brown-dwarf boundary.

sources.label: Palma-Bifani et al. 2023
sources.quote: a known companion at the exoplanet/ brown-dwarf boundary

introduction.text: AB Pic is a young K-type star in the Carina association. Its companion b, found in 2005, sits 5.4 arcseconds out on an orbit seen edge-on.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of Gaia's spectrum of the star. No surface picture exists.

color-brightness.title: Color + brightness, Nov 2025 to Jan 2026
color-brightness.summary: The star in its own color, darker where its light shows it darker; the contrast is drawn stronger to be seen.
